nodes.label: Stage 1 MobileNetV4-Conv-Small Student Distillation
nodes.rationale: Shows 10–20x throughput (<1.5 ms vs 35 ms ViT-B/14), proving production readiness; high-recall threshold τ1=0.02 fast-paths 75–80% of benign uploads while leaking <0.2% of fakes.

nodes.label: Multi-Crop vs Centre-Crop Under Social Compression
nodes.norm_label: multi-crop vs centre-crop under social compression
nodes.rationale: Multi-crop gave +0.051 AUC clean but zero gain under PTE (ΔAUC −0.014) because tiling made compression blocks on reals spuriously raise fake logits; keep crop_mode="center" by default, multi-crop opt-in for localized inpainting benchmarks.

nodes.label: Split-Conformal Prediction with Monotone Non-Conformity Scores
nodes.norm_label: split-conformal prediction with monotone non-conformity scores
nodes.rationale: Priority 1: pure post-processing (zero GPU) that bounds FPR ≤ α=0.01 via the (1−α) empirical quantile of P(fake) on held-out reals, with REAL / FLAG FAKE / ABSTAIN decision bands; fixes the 16.8% FNR spike.

nodes.label: Heterogeneous Ensembles (escalation tier)
nodes.rationale: In-the-wild SOTA but P99 latency and cost too high for front-door; use as offline/escalation tier.

nodes.label: TemporalAdapter (src/dfd/models/temporal.py)
nodes.rationale: Depthwise 1D convolutions (k=3,5) with residual scaling γ over [B,T,d] frame sequences.

nodes.norm_label: lora on top-3 block wq/wv projections (manifold perturbation)
nodes.rationale: Co-trained with Spatiotemporal Adapters to break off-the-shelf transferability of white-box attacks.

nodes.norm_label: spatiotemporal adapter temporal evasion (top-k pooling, dynamic keyframes)
nodes.rationale: Attackers confine manipulation to bursts/non-keyframes or smooth via RIFE/FILM interpolation; fixed stride misses them.

nodes.rationale: Open-weight DINOv2/v3/CLIP let attackers craft PGD/UAPs against the public backbone without the head.

nodes.rationale: Deepfake temporal glitches (facial feature drift) are localized, so averaging the top k=max(2,⌊0.25T⌋) frame logits avoids diluting sparse artifacts.

nodes.rationale: Split workloads across RunPod (batch training), Modal (serverless latency tests + demo hosting), Tinker (VLM SFT) and local MPS (smoke tests) so no single platform becomes a bottleneck.

nodes.label: OOD Calibration Breakdown (FNR 2.0% → 16.8%)
nodes.rationale: Temperature and thresholds fitted on known generators assume i.i.d. data; unseen generators are genuine OOD covariate shifts, so missed fakes surged from 2.0% to 16.8% on Midjourney.

nodes.norm_label: route fusion (logistic regression on core + vlm logits)

nodes.norm_label: d8: stage 3 vlm route (qwen3.6-vl lora sft on tinker)

nodes.rationale: Image size alone gave AUC 1.000 on GLIDE since all GenImage fakes are square; VLM sees aspect via token grid, so both classes get identical square crops.

nodes.rationale: Cuts beauty-filter false positives; label applied to both classes so it can't become a label proxy (lambda_b=0.2).

nodes.label: D9: Platform Transcoding Emulation (PTE)
nodes.rationale: Applied identically to both classes (1-3 hops of resize/JPEG/WebP/blur/beauty) to prevent format/compression shortcuts (DDA, PLADA); crop not resize preserves pixel traces.

nodes.label: DDA: Dual Data Alignment (NeurIPS 2025)
nodes.rationale: Detectors exploit image format/size as non-causal features, so JPEG/resize distributions must match between real and fake training data.

nodes.label: Aspect-Ratio & Dimension Leakage Shortcut
nodes.rationale: 100% of GenImage fakes were square while 98% of reals were not, giving an artificial 0.983 AUC; standardizing to DEFAULT_SQUARE_SIZE=448 reset true AUC to 0.871. Future video crops must use fixed 1:1 face boxes (1.35x margin) to avoid device-identity leakage.

nodes.label: Platform Transcoding Emulation (PTE)
nodes.rationale: Social networks apply resizing, cascaded H.264/HEVC/VP9/AV1, 4:2:0 chroma subsampling; training simulates multi-hop chains (WhatsApp -> CapCut -> upload).

nodes.label: Spatiotemporal Adapter (StA)
nodes.rationale: Lightweight dual-branch 1D temporal + 2D spatial depthwise convs (k=3,5) injected between frozen ViT blocks instead of heavy 3D-ViTs (VideoMAE); captures Facial Feature Drift at low latency.
